entities.name: Władysław Dybowski
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Władysław Dybowski was a Polish zoologist, and a brother of Benedykt Dybowski. He mainly studied invertebrates, and specialized in the study of molluscs, including fossil species. He also worked on specimens sent by his brother from Siberia.
